# 8. Dashboard and Measurement Plan

## Analytics Dashboard

The CPP Farm Store Omnichannel Performance Dashboard was developed in Looker Studio to demonstrate how CPP Farm Store could monitor ecommerce, marketing, product, and omnichannel performance.

The dashboard uses **simulated data for educational purposes** because complete live CPP Farm Store ecommerce data were not available.

## Measurement Objectives

The dashboard is designed to:

- Measure website traffic and customer activity
- Track product engagement
- Compare marketing-channel performance
- Evaluate campaign effectiveness
- Monitor purchases and revenue
- Identify high-performing products
- Measure store pickup interest
- Support future data-driven decisions

## Key Performance Indicators

- **Total Users:** 980
- **Sessions:** 1,138
- **Product Views:** 796
- **Purchases:** 126
- **Revenue:** $2,644
- **Conversion Rate:** 11.07%
- **Average Order Value:** $20.98
- **Store Pickup Interest:** 65

## Dashboard Visualizations

The dashboard includes:

- Website Sessions Over Time
- Sessions by Marketing Channel
- Purchases by Campaign
- Product Performance
- Campaign Performance
- Conversion Rate
- Average Order Value
- Store Pickup Interest

## Dashboard

![CPP Farm Store Omnichannel Performance Dashboard](images/Final%20Looker%20Studio%20Dashboard.png){width="95%"}

## Key Dashboard Insights

- Multiple channels contribute to website traffic, supporting an omnichannel marketing approach.
- High website traffic does not automatically mean stronger campaign performance.
- Campaigns should be evaluated using purchases, revenue, and conversion rate in addition to sessions.
- Product-level performance can identify where customers show interest but do not complete a purchase.
- Store Pickup Interest helps connect digital activity with the physical CPP Farm Store.

## Recommended Measurement Actions

CPP Farm Store should:

- Monitor traffic and conversion performance together.
- Invest more heavily in campaigns that generate purchases and revenue.
- Improve product pages when views do not translate into purchases.
- Make store pickup highly visible throughout the ecommerce experience.
- Regularly review dashboard data and adjust marketing decisions.
- Replace simulated data with live GA4 and Shopify data when available.

::: {.notes}
For this part of the project, we created a Looker Studio dashboard to show how CPP Farm Store could measure its omnichannel and ecommerce performance.

At the top of the dashboard, management can quickly see major KPIs such as users, sessions, purchases, revenue, conversion rate, average order value, and store pickup interest.

The dashboard also allows the Farm Store to compare marketing channels, campaigns, and individual products. One important takeaway is that generating traffic alone is not enough. CPP Farm Store should also look at whether that traffic leads to purchases and revenue.

Store pickup interest is especially important because it helps measure whether digital activity is helping customers transition from the online experience to the physical Farm Store.

Because our dashboard uses simulated data, these results should be viewed as a measurement framework. In the future, CPP Farm Store could connect real GA4, Shopify, advertising, and pickup data.
:::

# 10. Closing

## Connecting the Customer Experience

CPP Farm Store has an opportunity to create a stronger connection between its **physical location and digital customer experience**.

Our proposed strategy connects:

**Digital Discovery → Shopify → Product Information → Online Ordering → Store Pickup → Post-Purchase Engagement**

## Overall Value

The proposed omnichannel strategy can help CPP Farm Store:

- Increase product visibility
- Improve customer convenience
- Expand ecommerce opportunities
- Strengthen digital marketing
- Encourage online-to-store customer activity
- Use customer data to make better decisions
- Build stronger long-term relationships with customers

## Final Takeaway

CPP Farm Store does not need to replace its physical retail experience with ecommerce.

Instead, digital tools should make the existing Farm Store experience **easier to discover, easier to shop, and easier to measure**.

By gradually implementing Shopify ecommerce, improved product data, integrated campaigns, store pickup, and analytics, CPP Farm Store can create a more connected and convenient omnichannel experience for the Cal Poly Pomona community and surrounding customers.

::: {.notes}
Our overall recommendation is not to replace the physical CPP Farm Store with ecommerce. Instead, ecommerce should strengthen the physical store.

Customers should be able to discover products online, learn what is available, place an order, and then conveniently pick it up at the Farm Store.

The different parts of our project support that same journey. Shopify improves the shopping experience, the product feed improves discoverability, campaigns bring customers into the journey, creative content builds awareness, and the dashboard measures the results.

Overall, this strategy gives CPP Farm Store a practical foundation for future ecommerce growth while maintaining the local and community-focused experience that makes the Farm Store unique.
:::
